description: This file defines the BestSeller controller class for the OpenCart admin module, handling CRUD operations, reporting, installation, uninstallation, and synchronization of the bestseller module.

classes.name: BestSeller
classes.description: Controller class for managing the Best Seller module in OpenCart admin, including CRUD operations, reporting, installation, uninstallation, and synchronization.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the main page for the bestseller module, including loading language, setting breadcrumbs, retrieving module info, and rendering the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving module settings, validating permissions and input, and updating the module configuration.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs the bestseller module if the user has permission.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls the bestseller module if the user has permission.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new bestseller module instance if the user has permission.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified module instance if the user has permission.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates and returns the bestseller report HTML with pagination.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Synchronizes bestseller data with current product order totals, supporting pagination.
